name: Longest string of pairwise distinct consecutive prime gaps below 10^8
description: construct() -> {'start': p, 'length': k} with p prime, 1 <= k <= 200, and the k + 1 consecutive primes beginning at p all at most 10^8. The k gaps between them must be pairwise distinct. Maximize k; the optimum below 10^8 is 21. Among primes below 10^8 the longest string has 21 distinct gaps, so the task recovers it.

sources.locator: William D. Banks, Tristan Freiberg and Caroline L. Turnage-Butterbaugh, Consecutive primes in tuples (2015). Crossref record inspected (the paper produces arbitrarily long strings of consecutive primes with strictly increasing gaps, answering a question of Erdős and Turán). Erdős Problem #852 page inspected (Brun's sieve gives h(x) -> infinity). OEIS A053597 and its record positions A078515 inspected; the longest string of distinct gaps among primes below 10^8 was recomputed locally with a complete sieve: 21 gaps, starting at the prime 69931991, consistent with the OEIS records. Among primes below 10^8 the longest string has 21 distinct gaps, so the task recovers it.
